title.narrative: for a program to support and improve evidence-based decision making in sub-Saharan Africa

description.narrative: The Transfer Project is a regional initiative led by the University of North Carolina, the United Nations International Children’s Emergency Fund, and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations to generate evidence on impacts of national cash transfer programs in sub-Saharan Africa, and to translate that evidence into policy through partnerships with national governments. The Transfer Project conducts evaluations and research that respond to governments’ policy questions about social protection programs, and helps governments apply this evidence to decisions. This grant will support the University of North Carolina to engage with African policymakers and scholars to identify evidence gaps for high-value policymaking, conduct and support impact evaluations, educate members of the media and civil society about cash transfers, and increase the capacity of government policymakers to identify evidence gaps and commission and use evidence for decision making.
